description:
Read recent Unity Console entries without asking the user to copy logs. In Safe Mode or after a crash, fall back to the project Editor.log out of process and return its path with diagnostics.

Entries are chronological; duplicates are merged with count before the limit. level and levels combine with OR semantics. error includes assertions, exceptions, fatal logs, and compiler errors; warn and info select warnings and ordinary logs. Omit both for all levels. Connected scripts can also use ctx.GetConsoleLog(level, limit) or ctx.GetConsoleLog(levels, limit).

level.description: Optional single normalized Unity Console level to return.

levels.description: Optional normalized Unity Console levels to return with OR semantics, for example ["warn", "error"].

limit.description: Maximum number of merged log entries to return.
